name: NCA Validation (WinNonlin)
citation: Lee HY, Lee YJ (2009). Validation of bear with WinNonlin & SAS (Version 2). pkpd168.com.
description: Subject 1, Period 1 (Test) profile from a public bear/WinNonlin cross-validation report, validating AUC0t (linear trapezoidal) and lambda_z (manual, 3-point) against Phoenix WinNonlin V4.0.1 output.

name: Parallel Design PK Data
description: Eleven reference datasets for parallel-group bioequivalence (P01-P11) from Fuglsang (2015). Each dataset has published reference values for both Welch-Satterthwaite (FDA-recommended for unequal variances) and classical (equal-variance) 90% confidence intervals - PE is the same for both. Coverage: small balanced (P01), small imbalanced (P02), extreme variability (P03, P11), moderate (P04), large balanced (P05-P09), large imbalanced (P10-P11). Validates the parallel branch of perform_be_analysis(): log-transformation, two-sample comparison (Welch and standard), point estimate, 90% CI on the difference of log-means, back-transformation, and the 80-125% acceptance decision.

name: 2x2 Crossover PK Data
description: Eight reference datasets for the standard 2-treatment, 2-period, 2-sequence crossover (A-H) from Schutz, Labes & Fuglsang (2014). Reference PE / 90% CI cross-validated across EquivTest/PK, SAS, WinNonlin, and R (consensus values - Kinetica diverges on imbalanced sets C and H, illustrating the need for proper validation). Coverage: A (Sauter 1992 balanced), B (Clayton & Leslie 1981 balanced), C (imbalanced via subject deletion), D (extreme range via x10^6 scaling), E (with single-subject outlier), F (n=100, non-Gaussian residual), G (n=1000 simulated, balanced), H (n=1000 with imbalance, outliers, and extreme range). Validates the 2x2x2 branch of perform_be_analysis(): fixed-effects ANOVA with sequence / subject(sequence) / period / treatment terms, point estimate, 90% CI, intra-subject CV, and the 80-125% pass/fail conclusion.

name: Replicate Design PK Data
citation: Schütz H, Labes D, Tomashevskiy M, González-de la Parra M, Shitova A, Fuglsang A (2020) AAPS J 22(2):44; replicateBE R package
description: Thirty cross-validated replicate-design datasets shipped with the replicateBE R package (rds01-rds30). Coverage spans full and partial replicates (TRTR/RTRT, TRR/RTR/RRT, TRT/RTR, TRRT/RTTR, TTRR/RRTT, Balaam, 4-sequence FDA archive datasets), CVwR from ~5% to >60%, balanced and imbalanced designs, dropouts, missing/NA period data, extreme outliers, label-switching, and the critical Method A vs Method B disagreement edge case (rds14). Validates the replicate branch of perform_be_analysis(): Method A (fixed-effects ANOVA), Method B (mixed model via lme4 / lmerTest), CVwR estimation, scaled-ABE widening (EMA / HC / GCC), point estimate, 90% CI, and the conventional vs expanded BE limit decision logic.

name: TTT Lambda-z Point Selection
purpose: Internal consistency check: BioEQ's own TTT (2x-Tmax) lambda_z point-selection rule
citation: BioEQ-generated synthetic dataset - internal algorithm consistency check, not benchmarked against external software.
description: 3 synthetic single-arm profiles with different Tmax values, hand-computed against BioEQ's TTT rule (R/nca_pknca.R): a primary-rule case (3 points), a fallback-rule case (3 points via the <3-point fallback), and a wide-window case (6 points) proving the algorithm uses the full 2xTmax-to-Tlast range with no truncation.

name: Missing Data Handling
purpose: Internal consistency check: BioEQ's own middle/terminal missing-data handling rules
citation: BioEQ-generated synthetic dataset - internal algorithm consistency check, not benchmarked against external software.
description: One profile derived from the bear/WinNonlin Subject 1/Period 1 reference profile, with a BLQ point and two blanked points (one middle, one terminal), run through handle_missing_data() (R/missing_data_handling.R) under all three real app selections: exclude (complete), interpolate, and LOCF - verifying BLQ->0, middle-gap handling, and terminal-gap handling each behave as specified.

name: Carryover Detection
purpose: Internal consistency check: BioEQ's own ICH M13A carryover detection rule
citation: BioEQ-generated synthetic dataset - internal algorithm consistency check, not benchmarked against external software.
description: 3 synthetic 2-period crossover subjects sharing an identical Period-2 Cmax, with pre-dose concentrations at 0.2%, 8.0%, and exactly 5.0% of that Cmax, run through detect_carryover() (R/carryover_detection.R) - verifying the ICH M13A 5% threshold, including the > vs >= boundary case.

name: Theoph NCA Validation (WinNonlin)
purpose: NCA validation against Phoenix WinNonlin for lin-up/log-down AUC and ARS best-fit lambda_z
citation: Bae KS (2018). Development of R packages 'NonCompart' and 'ncar' for noncompartmental analysis (NCA). Transl Clin Pharmacol 26(1):10-15.
description: All 12 subjects of the base-R Theoph dataset (oral theophylline) with published Phoenix WinNonlin 6.3/7.0 NCA output, cross-validated via the NonCompart R package project. Validates BioEQ's ARS (adjusted-R2 best-fit) lambda_z selection - point counts genuinely vary across subjects (3-7) - and both AUC integration methods (linear trapezoidal and linear-up/log-down).

name: NCA Internal Consistency Checks
purpose: Internal consistency checks: AUC integration edge cases and ARS tie-break behavior
citation: BioEQ-generated synthetic/derived datasets - internal algorithm consistency checks, not benchmarked against external software.
description: Two BioEQ-generated checks: (1) three short profiles (design from PKNCA's own AUC-integration-methods vignette) exercising lin-up/log-down's Clast-below-LLOQ and zero-concentration edge cases, expected values re-derived independently from the closed-form formulas; (2) an ARS tie-break regression test on the existing nca_pending profile, where the 3-point and 4-point fits differ by only 6.9e-06 adjusted R-squared.
